en: Black‑and‑white view down a broad, tree‑lined city street with a dirt or cobblestone surface. On the left foreground stands a horse‑drawn carriage beside large wooden houses. Farther down the street are taller masonry commercial buildings, including a prominent multi‑story structure with a tower-like section. Pedestrians and additional carriages are visible in the distance. The overall appearance suggests a late‑19th‑ or very early‑20th‑century urban scene. No visible caption or printed text appears on the front.
